member: a Westinghouse-type PWR at the start of its fuel cycle (1690 ppm), load-following with rods and boron

alpha_coolant.why: start-of-cycle MTC at hot full power, the physics review's judgment (finding 2); the owner narrowed it from 0 to -20 on 2026-11-10, after the sweep showed the weak end cannot carry the member's 5 %/min returns

boron_worth.why: BEAVRS hot zero power 10.8 to 10.9 pcm/ppm; NRC search summaries 6.7 and 8.2 at power

restart_steps.why: a scram's restart, 24 to 70 h (Doel-3; APR1400)

floor_allowed.why: time to restore Tavg above its floor, 15 to 30 min

coupled_why: both follow the core's boron (ours, from the physics): more boron makes the MTC less negative and each ppm worth less, so the MTC's most negative end (-18) goes with the largest worth (-10.9), as BEAVRS measures 10.8 at lower boron
